title: A trim request the API can trust
heading: The Request Is a Pydantic Model, and FastAPI Refuses What It Does Not Fit
cases: a valid request gets 200 and a negative budget gets 422
a budget of zero is a real budget, and a circuit cost below zero is refused
a circuit with zero miles is refused, while a short one is accepted
two circuits with the same id are refused
a request with no circuits is refused
a misspelled top-level field is refused instead of ignored
a misspelled field inside a circuit is refused instead of ignored
a circuit with an empty id is refused
